purpose: Teach: うんちく/コトバ/一安心/すませ/まちがい/つづい/マイペース/大雑把

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒー豆のうんちくをお話されてたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was telling you all about coffee beans earlier, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, gently observant. Soft opening, slight smile in the voice. Conversational pace, the tone of someone noticing a small, pleasant thing. Trailing upward slightly on the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英語のコトバを混ぜてお話されるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really does mix in English words when he talks, doesn't he?
lines.style: Light, noticing tone. Unhurried delivery. A gentle observation offered without judgment, almost thinking aloud. Slight warmth on the realization.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がご無事でお戻りになって、一安心ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's nice that the customer made it back safely. That's a relief.
lines.style: Soft, genuine concern underneath. Slow, measured pace. The quiet relief of someone who genuinely cares about someone else's wellbeing. Slight exhale on 'relief'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お支払をすませてお帰りになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer finished paying and headed out.
lines.style: Straightforward, calm. Matter-of-fact but not cold. Light, observational tone. Neutral pacing, the simple statement of what happened. No edge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メニューにまちがいがないか、確認しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's double-check the order so there aren't any mistakes.
lines.style: Gentle but purposeful. Not commanding — more like thinking together. Clear, direct pacing. The voice of someone who's learned that small attention prevents larger problems.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の改装、つづいて進んでるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The store renovations are moving along nicely.
lines.style: Observant, pleased. Moderate pace, conversational. A small note of satisfaction — things progressing as they should. Warm but unforced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のマイペースなお時間の使い方、素敵ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's lovely how the customer takes their time and enjoys the pace they set.
lines.style: Genuine admiration in a quiet voice. Slow, thoughtful pace. The appreciation of someone who values presence. Soft, almost tender delivery without overselling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お掃除を大雑把にすると、後で大変よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: If you rush the cleaning, it'll be much harder to fix later.
lines.style: Gentle but clear guidance. Moderate pace, practical tone. Not harsh — the voice of experience offering care through honesty. Slight weight on the consequence without urgency.
